author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Codex is dumb.  It took over my computer all in a sudden while I am working.

I have so many sessions running and it took me awhile for figure out who took over my computer, I have to fight for it with the mouse control for the mean time.

It turns out it picked the computer-use tool instead of the built-in browser to test a website.

Maybe I should disable computer-use in Codex.
